Name: Berries For The Bushes - Foraging
Author: lunightmare
Description:
[center][size=6][i][b]~ Berries For Bushes ~[/b]
[/i]
[/size][size=4]More berries for foraging!
[/size]
They are just tiny simple berries,
but I really wanted to make this!
Now, when foraging randomly, you might find
berries on the bushes every few days.
On spring, there are pink and yellow,
on summer, blue and red,
and on fall, you'll find purple and green!
There are crops for these berries,
these crops will give you from 5 to 10 of each
but it might be difficult for you to find them.[/center]
[size=5][i][center][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/center]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has two folders inside with the names of the mods.
[size=3]· Place them in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]


[i][size=4][u][b]By:  ~ Luna ~[/b][/u][/size][/i]
